steps.text:
Implemented terminal quick-fix telemetry improvements.

- Emits `quickFixId` and `ranQuickFix` instead of inferring success from a later command.
- Records command, opener, and custom quick-fix executions immediately.
- Records unselected quick fixes as dismissed when the next command completes.
- Added coverage confirming command quick fixes emit their provider ID.

Changed [quickFixAddon.ts](/app/src/vs/workbench/contrib/terminal/browser/xterm/quickFixAddon.ts) and [quickFixAddon.test.ts](/app/src/vs/workbench/contrib/terminal/test/browser/quickFixAddon.test.ts).
